name: Money Smell
look: A blurry, reddish still of Vince McMahon, the white-haired WWE boss, in a purple suit and pink tie, holding a thick banded stack of cash up to his face with his mouth open, as if sniffing it, against a dark background.
use: A reaction for sniffing out money. It goes with a caption about a payday, a profitable idea or a deal too good to pass up, showing someone savoring the smell of cash.
slots: the payday or moneymaking chance (caption above)
examples: When the tax refund finally hits my account
describe: old man in a purple suit sniffing a stack of cash
wrestling boss smelling a wad of money
white haired guy holding dollar bills to his nose
rich guy breathing in the smell of cash
